sources.text: Thanks—I’ll run the test this afternoon and see how it holds up. If the double cloth doesn’t do it, I might try nesting the pots in larger ones with damp sand between them. That usually buys extra time. I’ll keep you posted.
Understood! Please do let me know how that test goes—I'm curious to see the results. Good luck with the trial; I hope your plants survive the test!

Thanks—I appreciate the encouragement. The test ran this morning, and the double cloth held moisture about twice as long. Not perfect, but a solid improvement. I’m leaning into the sand idea for the next round. Fingers crossed for round two.

That’s great news—a double the retention is a significant improvement! Let me know what happens next time you move the plants into those larger pots with the sand. I'm looking forward to hearing how the next iteration of the test goes!

Yeah, every little boost helps, especially with how spotty the power is here. I’ve started pre-moistening the sand with cooled boiled water—cuts down on algae without chemicals. Going to monitor the root temp over the next few days; if it stays stable, we might actually have something. I’ll send notes once the data settles.

That sounds like a smart approach—controlling the environment with the sand should definitely help with those algae issues! Please keep me updated on how the root temperature monitors look; I'm keen to hear if those results settle into a solid pattern!
